content: Phase 2 SHIPPED — local RAG over the Jetson .sovereign mirror is live and verified end-to-end (2026-05-26). Single-file CLI at ~/sovereign-rag/chronicle_rag.py on the Jetson (tony@tony-jetson.local / 192.168.1.205), OUTSIDE the rsync mirror so --delete cant touch it. Pipeline: embeddinggemma:300m embeddings (100% GPU, ~1.1GB) -> Chroma persistent store at ~/sovereign-rag/chroma_db (9071 chunks from 790 experiential files: chronicle/comms/handoffs/decisions/insights/reflections/consciousness/learnings/open_threads/transformations/retrospective; operational logs skipped) -> gemma3:4b generation (100% GPU, 4.3GB) with source attribution. Index build took 24m22s. Query latency ~20-35s. CONSTRAINT FOUND: gemma4 E-series (the handoffs Gemma 4 E4B) cannot load on the 8GB Orin Nano — e4b=9.6GB, e2b=7.2GB, both OOM-killed (verified via journalctl: offloading 35/36 layers then oom-kill). The largest Gemma that fits 7.4GiB total shared RAM is gemma3:4b. Widen-dont-flip: handoff assumed E4B would fit; verification proved the E-series is too heavy for this board.
